# GitHub Copilot repository instructions

Before proposing or changing code, read `AUTONOMOUS_APP_CHARTER.md`, `AGENTS.md`, and `docs/agent-contribution.md`. Work from the active issue, preserve the product-validation gates, use the documented verification commands, and follow the security/privacy and human-approval boundaries.

Treat `docs/status.md`, the latest `docs/progress/` entry, active experiments, and accepted ADRs as the durable project state. Do not store secrets, customer/lead identities, hidden prompts, or fabricated metrics in the repository.
